title: Internal: handling procedure for logging a late cancellation on a Personal Training Packages package
content:
## Applicable situation
This document covers the Personal Training Packages product line. When a member cancels a scheduled coaching session within the applicable late-cancellation window, the agent logs the late cancellation against the member's package and records the total charge for it. This applies while the package's own status is active.

## How it is invoked
This is an internal tool that must first be unlocked (unlock) and then called (call): log_late_cancellation_b8e4e034.

## Parameters
- pt_holding_id: the reference number of the personal-training package the late cancellation is logged against, reachable by looking up the member's packages before this call.
- session_type: exactly one of: standard (an ordinary coaching session), specialty_nutrition (a nutrition-focused coaching session), specialty_rehab (a rehabilitation-focused coaching session); use the kind of session that was cancelled.
- trainer_name: the name of the trainer originally assigned to this session, copied character for character from what the caller or the package's own trainer-of-record states.
- cancellation_amount_usd: the total amount to charge for this late cancellation, in US dollars, rounded to exactly 2 decimal places, already combining every applicable fee component (the tier's own late-cancellation fee net of any corporate wellness reduction, plus any habitual surcharge that applies).

## Return
On success, a confirmation naming the new ledger entry's reference number, the amount charged, and the package's session balance after the forfeiture; the presence of a new reference number indicates the late cancellation was recorded successfully. If the named package does not exist, the tool returns an error stating that no personal-training package matches the given reference number, and no ledger entry is created.
